title: Datadog US1 - Event Monitors - Scheduled Maintenance
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: Event Monitors - Scheduled Maintenance
Status: completed
Impact: none

Scheduled until: 2015-09-29T17:45:00.000-04:00
Updates:
- 2015-09-29T17:33:56.853-04:00: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2015-09-29T17:16:21.183-04:00: scheduled - We will be performing proactive maintenance for a window of no longer than 15 minutes.

The window will start at 29 SEP 2015, 17:30 EDT (21:30 UTC).

During this period, Event Monitors will be temporarily suspended to remove false positive alarms.

*Most importantly*, all of your data will be processed.

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@datadoghq.com.
